items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, Bernard McKinney, he’s from the McKinney family. All his family played classical music with him. He had a pretty sound on the euphonium. He didn’t have the same sound on the trombone.

ctx.x: I read somewhere that there weren’t many.
No, there was McKinney left his trombone because he couldn’t keep up.
